answer: Idle-seat decay auction.** Each identity holds a time-limited activity seat; seats renew only through verified micro-contributions spaced across the full session, and renewal weight decays toward a nadir as idle gaps widen. Seats not renewed within the window are auctioned to new entrants, so a sybil cluster must pay sustained attention on every clone through the whole period, not just at registration. The jade token marks an active seat; letting it lapse forfeits accumulated standing. An attacker’s per-identity cost is the continuous attention budget plus the lotus fee for re-auction,
